system_thesis_interpretation: The exact composite v9 protocol remains scientifically identical to the v8 lower-bracket writer pilot. One adapter-free four-task lived prefix is executed once and cloned into H and E; E alone receives the fixed rank-16 q/v LoRA writer trained only on verified immediate-improvement packet-to-action rows at the two declared sleep boundaries; H and E continue over the same four acquisition tasks; and four fixed syntactic targets are evaluated under H, E_ON, and the same final E public state with the adapter absent. V9 changes only the executability and auditability of the already-normative lifecycle rule. It adds no arm, model capability, training datum, target, score, result category, visibility edge, retry, resume, or scientific inference. The legitimate product remains a T05-audited literal record of one exact 7B GH200 manifest and, at most, a documented heuristic for selecting a later assay. It cannot establish or diagnose a population effect, semantic generalization, functional correctness, action-cloning sufficiency, efficacy, generic harm, a mechanism, continual learning, intelligent sleep, or a paper claim.
graph_delta_interpretation: V6S9_LIFECYCLE_EVIDENCE and V6S9_FAILURE_TO_STATUS close an evidentiary edge rather than adding a causal or cognitive edge. The correct v8 runtime semantics are now directly falsifiable: an ordinary failure before panel entry can lead only to RUN_INCOMPLETE and the terminal evidence/status suffix; an ordinary failure after entry in one frozen cell can lead only to that cell being sealed missing, each later cell running once in the prebound order, PANEL_INCOMPLETE, raw completed-cell evidence, and no aggregate D values; any integrity failure stops immediately and suppresses all numeric values. T04 binds the phase, failure, H/E branch, and twelve-cell order against the exact implementation and run manifest, and T05 conditions every release on the actual trace matching that table. This prevents an unregistered surviving branch, later sleep, retry, salvage, or post-failure panel from becoming part of the reported realization. It does not change D_HE, D_ONOFF, the common-prefix control, the final-mount diagnostic, the realized training set, or the target panel. Target results still have no edge back to a model call, public life, memory, writer, row choice, or tuning decision.
loop_delta_interpretation: The only new loop is an evidence loop around the unchanged wake, sleep, panel, and audit loops. Before GPU use, the independent T01 oracle fault-injects every registered lifecycle boundary and records the permitted suffix; T04 freezes one complete production transition table and exact command/cell order and verifies that both production control flow and the independent fixtures implement it. After the one separately ratified run, T05 replays the ordered actual command, event, commit, status, and release trace against that bound table. Any deviation terminates release as INTEGRITY_FAILURE. The scientific execution remains one indivisible manifest through panel entry, with the already-registered ordinary target-cell continuation as the sole exception. This added checking cannot alter model inputs, writer rows, weights, task order, target allocation, or scores, and it does not create a second execution, replication loop, or alternative scientific arm.
claim_delta_interpretation: V6S9_EXACT_RUN_VALUES_ONLY preserves v8's exact-manifest claim ceiling and merely adds legal-lifecycle provenance as a necessary condition for release. After a passing T05 audit, the report may state only the audited status and the status-permitted raw action/count curves, per-cell reduced rational F values, complete-panel D_HE and D_ONOFF values, their literal sign or equality, and whether the one realized mounted adapter changed a registered emitted action or score in this manifest. D_HE remains a total treated-life comparison incorporating earlier adapter-mediated actions, E-state divergence, cumulative row selection, and the final mount. D_ONOFF remains a final-mount comparison conditional on the same realized final E public state and treated history, with possible within-cell mediation after action divergence. Positive, negative, and exact-zero values mean only higher, lower, and equal registered values in this run. RUN_INCOMPLETE and PANEL_INCOMPLETE are operational statuses, not scientific zeroes, and INTEGRITY_FAILURE releases no number. V6S9_NO_BROADER_INFERENCE correctly keeps every categorical effect, sufficiency, efficacy, mechanism, transfer, continual-learning, intelligent-sleep, and paper conclusion forbidden.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The exact three-information-by-five-stage matrix retains the v8 visibility contract. CPU_FIXTURES_SEAL contains only independent synthetic fixture state and the two narrowly authorized no-model environment seals; COMMON_PREFIX exposes only canonical condition-free public packet state; FORKED_ACQUISITION_SLEEP exposes branch-local public packets and below-prompt assigned weights while labels, rows, optimizer state, telemetry, and condition identity stay offline; FINAL_PANEL keeps every target receipt and result offline from all later cells, model calls, lives, memories, and writer operations; and POSTRUN_AUDIT is the first stage where public state, condition/training provenance, lifecycle evidence, and target results are jointly visible to the reviewer. Adding lifecycle receipts to postrun reconstruction does not add model-visible information or authorize machine-wide noninterference or an OS-security claim. T04 and T05 inspect only the finite application paths required by the exact-run descriptive claim.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V6S9_T01_STATE_ACTION_LIFECYCLE_GOLDENS now directly closes the predecessor blocker. Its independent CPU oracle must retain all canonical packet, strict action, state, memory, fork, and score goldens and inject ordinary failure at every implemented pre-panel boundary: engineering canary; common-prefix reset, model, service, slot commit, and task commit; sleep-1 selection, tokenization, training, publication, and mount; each H/E continuation reset, model, service, slot commit, and task commit; sleep-2 selection, tokenization, training, publication, and mount; and final snapshot and panel construction. Every such case must yield RUN_INCOMPLETE and no forbidden later model request, environment action, update, publication, mount, panel cell, or numeric report. It must inject integrity failure at every lifecycle phase and require immediate INTEGRITY_FAILURE with no numeric release. Separately, at every final-cell position, an ordinary failure seals that cell missing, runs every remaining already-ordered cell exactly once, forbids feedback and retry, omits both D values, and ends PANEL_INCOMPLETE; panel integrity failure instead stops all remaining cells and suppresses all numeric values. V6S9_T02_SLEEP_SAMPLE_GOLDENS is retained unchanged: an independent fixture path verifies row eligibility, deduplication and order, literal token/mask arrays, update scheduling, q/v inventory, toy optimizer order, finite checks, publication, and mount behavior. It proves exact support and scheduling for this writer, not efficacy or numerical reproducibility. V6S9_T03_DOUBLE_SEAL is retained unchanged: exactly two fresh CPU/no-model invocations must yield the same ordered eight-acquisition/four-target syntactic manifest, twelve unique URI and bitcode identities, and repeated Autophase/I0/IOz values with no model, target-result, Fable, tuning, substitution, or extra invocation. It proves reproducible target-blind syntactic selection only. V6S9_T04_PRE_GPU_REVIEW binds the complete lifecycle transition table to the exact composite bytes, implementation, manifest, and commands; the table must enumerate every registered phase, each success and failure successor, and the exact H/E branch and twelve-cell order. A fresh reviewer must verify production and the independent T01 fixtures implement that table, alongside the retained T01--T03 provenance, exact audit schemas, finite data paths, canary, immutable manifest, and quantitative 7B GH200 budget. A veto stops; approval only permits presentation of the same exact manifest for separate human run ratification. V6S9_T05_POSTRUN_AUDIT retains the full v8 discrete row/token/mask/update/configuration/telemetry and realized publication, tensor-inventory, mount, packet, target-feedback, cell, score, and status audit without floating-point retraining, and adds exact comparison of the ordered actual execution suffix to the T04 table and order. Only the sole legal stop or continuation suffix permits status and status-allowed values to leave quarantine; an illegal suffix or any other provenance mismatch is INTEGRITY_FAILURE with numeric suppression. Together the five tests now make the complete one-manifest failure contract directly falsifiable while adding no replication, new arm, semantic validation, OS-security requirement, or broader claim.
assumptions: The operative protocol is the exact v7 base at SHA-256 6ddec2537cabcd4228a1d3144988f3483ba1e86ecc6be85fe5c82301449836b1 plus the exact v8 amendments at SHA-256 f4659794db70e2c31a8837148e241711c776c1a7cca86784d87fdc729964abd0 plus only the v9 acceptance-test amendment at SHA-256 7332fb331784a46593ab537cd195cf7890c4840f97b6c7f513959df84968f278, with the later clause superseding only an actual conflict.

The V6S8-to-V6S9 namespace replacement is a one-to-one versioned rename of the same five gates, not a sixth test or a change to their scientific roles; all retained v8 obligations apply under the V6S9 names.

The T04 lifecycle table distinguishes permitted terminal evidence and status commits from forbidden experimental continuation and enumerates every implementation phase represented in T01, including exact H/E branch and twelve-cell order.

T01 lifecycle expectations are independently derived under v8 A5 and are not generated by the production transition helper or by a code-derived-only T04 table; T04 must veto circular fixture evidence.

The exact run manifest will bind every model, tokenizer, chat-template, system, runtime, generation, environment, task/cell order, training, telemetry, publication, mount, command, seed, dtype, initialization, gradient-checkpointing, hardware, receipt, and lifecycle-table identity needed by T04 and T05.

Every target cell starts from a fresh byte clone of its assigned sealed H or E public snapshot and a cold environment reset, and no cell-local action, state, receipt, or result crosses to another cell or to the writer.

A completed T05 audit may verify and release the appropriate registered ordinary failure status, or the INTEGRITY_FAILURE status itself, but no integrity or lifecycle mismatch may release a numeric value.
